Residency pact with an independent settlement

To sign, each side must pay: this city, 120 knowledge, 20 wood, 4 tools; the other side, 60 knowledge, 20 wood, 4 tools. Afterward, every 10 seconds this city spends 0.08 knowledge and 0.1 wood; the other side spends 0.04 knowledge and 0.1 wood. If either side lacks the required resources, neither side is charged that round.

For every 600 seconds of continuous compliance, an additional residency quota of 24 people is approved, up to a total of 480. Quota on paper does not create people. Before receiving people, verify the age structure of those remaining at the place of origin, travel funds, passenger vehicles, and available beds at the destination.
Suspending the pact stops routine charges and approval of new quotas. Unused additional quota is frozen for now; resuming compliance will not reissue quota already used. {分支1}

This settlement has joined common law under a separate accession pact. Any new resettlement convoy must also verify accession compliance, as well as the existing minimums for those remaining, vehicles, and available beds.
The place of origin remains self-governing and independent; it is not part of the country's territory or directly governed population.

Residence and jurisdiction

Whether surveyed or party to a pact, people remain where they are. Shared services cover only the public affairs set out in the treaty; they do not mean the central government takes over local administration.
